variance_roundoff: variance=sumsq/N-(sum/N)^2; fail below -64*eps64*max(1,sumsq/N+(sum/N)^2), otherwise negative roundoff becomes0; strictly positive variance ranking
aggregation_dtype: float64 from unchanged source float32 values
export_effect_dtype: float32 with complete float64 atomic cache retained
export_state_dtype: float64; state_A/state_B have no second transform
raw_value_access: CSR index integrity scan can read all source indices; expression slices request ONLY selected control rows until gene panels are sealed, then ONLY admitted treated rows; physical HDF5 chunks may contain additional rows
raw_hash: one complete byte-level SHA256 before numerical passes, stable size/mtime/ctime/inode/device afterward; byte hashing is provenance I/O, not statistical expression access
